gameDescriptionHtml:
Experience the newest iteration of FieldSENSE in Madden NFL 24. More realistic character movement and smarter AI gives you control to play out your gameplay strategy with the confidence to dominate any opponent.

Game Features

  • FIELDSENSE – For the first time ever, FieldSENSE is coming to PC in Madden NFL 24. Get increased control in throwing, catching, tackling, and blocking with a suite of new animations added to Hit Everything 2.0 and Skill-Based Passing 2.0.
  • SAPIEN TECHNOLOGY – All-new character technology transforms the way players look and move with realistic redesigned player models that have more detail and variation than previously possible.
  • SUPERSTAR: THE LEAGUE – Select your position and body type, and customize your Superstar to complete objectives – like the NFL Combine – to help determine your Draft order.
  • SUPERSTAR SHOWDOWN – Further progress your avatar and play with and against friends in 3v3 matchups. Call your plays on the fly like a dominant superstar, get real-time player grading, and do it in style sporting the hottest gear in the game.
  • FRANCHISE – Set the stage to be a Super Bowl powerhouse. Play new mini games and training camp drills to progress your team. Utilize a more streamlined team relocation feature with new cities and new uniforms to create your own Franchise story.
  • CONTROLS & CUSTOMIZATION – Madden NFL 24 for PC has all the customization and control options you need to Call Your Number, including: controller support, up to 21:9 widescreen resolution, unlocked framerates up to 300fps (or as fast as your hardware allows).
  • RAY-TRACING – Ray-tracing technology is available on compatible hardware.
  • CROSS-PLAY – Connect with players across platforms then show them what electrifying talent looks like in competitive modes like Online H2H and more.
